page.overview:
Who is Kung Lao?

Kung Lao (Chinese: 空佬) is a character in the Mortal Kombat series. A Shaolin Monks and close friend to series protagonist Liu Kang, he is a student of Master Bo' Rai Cho and Champion of the Thunder God Raiden. He has remained one of the franchise's most popular characters and has been a central supporting character through out his appearances in the franchise.

Kung Lao made his playable debut in Mortal Kombat II and has been a playable character in almost every game since his debut. He is one of two titular protagonists of the spin-off game Mortal Kombat: Shaolin Monks alongside Liu Kang.

Kung Lao returned in the franchise reboot in Mortal Kombat (2011) once again as a supporting character. He later gains an antagonistic role in Mortal Kombat X and Mortal Kombat 11 as one of the many Revenant characters in the games' respective Story Modes.

A new version of Kung Lao returns in Mortal Kombat 1 as a playable character, serving as a supporting character in the game's Story Mode.
